notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

Mario Kart Wii (WiiCompiled): a crash during a race no longer breaks every
start after it. The game warms up a cache of everything it has drawn at
each start; one bad entry made it crash at the same point every time.
After a renderer crash the console sets that cache aside and the next
start rebuilds it.

WiFi turned off by a docked session comes back reliably, and the WiFi
page says when the radio is off, with a Turn WiFi on button.

Stick drift in GameCube games on pads whose sticks rest off centre is
fixed by calibrating: Calibrate Control Sticks now records where each
stick rests and tells Dolphin. Run it again for both sticks.

The Debug bundle carries Mario Kart Wii's session logs and a Network
section; the controller export carries a stick-at-rest sample.

stable.notes:
The whole 2.39 series, now on the Stable channel. If this console was on
2.39.0, this is everything since.

This update carries a kernel: the console restarts once for the update and
once more on its own about a minute after the first boot. Do not power off
while it says part 2 of 2.

Screen tearing in emulators is fixed: the display now composites and flips
the whole screen at vblank, handheld and docked. Tear-free display is a
switch in Settings > Display and Sound > Display, on by default.

Controllers and the volume rocker no longer die after days of uptime.

New: a Sega Saturn tab (Kronos or YabaSanshiro per game, both installed by
this update, needs your own Saturn BIOS), Game Gear, Virtual Boy, Moonlight and Morrowind under Ports
and Apps, PS2 achievements and memory cards on a fresh console, Open Cemu
on Wii U games, Shuffle on the Search tab, cover art upload on the web page.

Uploads: stuck extractions stop with a reason, USB and SD imports are
verified before the original is deleted, cue and bin halves find each other.

Settings: Display and Sound is five short pages, colour and background
sliders, Clean Light everywhere, home screen overlay toggles, bracketed
game name tags hidden by default. The RAM tuner finishes sooner.
